goal: Enables users to send payments to BIP 352 silent payment addresses
Allows fee-bumping silent payment transactions without creating unspendable outputs
reviewability: Ready for review after rebase onto the prerequisite PR
agreement: Verified compatibility by matching hundreds of test outputs with an external wallet (fametrano)
Verified coin selection and fee bumping through testing (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: bumping after restoring a backup can cause missed outputs (Yudis-bit)
Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob, polespinasa, davidgumberg)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it adds a major user privacy feature by allowing sends to silent payment addresses
Recipients gain privacy against address reuse without requiring interactive setup
